description: Workbook relationships, shared strings, and multi-sheet tables should render deterministically.
notes: The converter compacts offset sub-tables inside a sheet while the reference builder pads them to absolute column positions, so table shapes diverge even though cell content matches exactly (content precision/recall = 1.0). Threshold pins the current floor (table_similarity 0.44 observed); raise it when builder and converter agree on sub-table layout semantics.
